# read_cif_string { #mofography.data.read_cif_string }

`data.read_cif_string(cif)`

It takes a string of CIF data and returns an ASE atoms object.

## Parameters

| Name   | Type   | Description              | Default    |
|--------|--------|--------------------------|------------|
| `cif`  |        | The CIF file as a string | _required_ |

## Returns

| Type   | Description           |
|--------|-----------------------|
|        | the ASE atoms object. |
